title: abies vejarii subsp. mexicana
intro: Abies vejarii subsp. mexicana, commonly known as Mexican fir, is a coniferous evergreen tree species native to the mountainous regions of Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Abies vejarii subsp. mexicana include pain relief, wound healing, and immune system modulation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
